copper mountain.note: Hello and Good Morning! Copper's weather report is 2" of new snow overnight and its still coming down with another 4-6" possible, making everything look a little more like winter today. It'll be breezy, with a west northwest wind around 15-20mph and gusting near the 40's with temps around 33°. Copper is also hosting the World Cup race this weekend in East village. Event schedule can be found here! Enjoy the new snow and we'll see you out there.

eldora.note: 5:22 AM update – Good morning, skiers and riders! Welcome to the Eldora snow report for Saturday, November 28, 2026. The first Saturday of our winter operating season brings fresh snow: about two inches on the snow stake as of 5:20 AM, with an additional three to five inches throughout the day. Alpenglow chair will spin at 8:30 AM today, serving 1,000 vertical feet of terrain across two top-to-bottom runs, including Hornblower, Windmill, Klondike, and International. Season pass prices go up Tuesday! Save with summer pricing on Eldora Season Passes and lesson products through Monday, Nov 30. Give yourself more days on snow, or give someone you love a winter they won't forget. NWS Weather Snapshot : Snow showers, mainly before 5pm. Patchy blowing snow. Temperature falling to around 20 by 5pm. Windy, with a west wind 21 to 26 mph decreasing to 9 to 14 mph in the afternoon. Winds could gust as high as 43 mph. Chance of precipitation is 90%. New snow accumulation of 3 to 5 inches possible. Safety: No trees or glades are open yet. Expect thin, early-season conditions and be prepared to ski and ride safely and responsibly all season long, bearing in mind Your Responsibility Code every time you hit the slopes. Uphill/Nordic/Snowshoe Access is currently CLOSED. For the cross-country skiers, snowshoers, and uphill skiers out there, Eldora’s Nordic trail network and uphill access routes are NOT YET OPEN. Stay tuned here for updates. Parking: We will begin charging fees for single-occupancy vehicle (SOV) arrivals sometime in December. Stay tuned here for updates on when fees will begin. Learn more about parking at Eldora here . Stay informed: Before heading to the mountain this winter, always check this page, eldora.com/conditions , for the latest information and operational updates. You can also sign up for text alerts so you never miss a beat. Text one of the following keywords to (866) 965-6224 for alerts (message and data rates may apply). ELDORA for general alerts UPHILL for uphill-specific updates NORDIC for Nordic updates. Thanks for checking the Eldora snow report. We'll see you on the hill! -- GENERAL INFORMATION Lift Hours: 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM on weekdays, 8:30 AM to 4:00 PM on weekends. Lifts currently open: Alpenglow only. Lodge Hours: 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM on weekdays, 7:30 AM to 4:30 PM on weekends. Lodges currently open: Timbers, West Wing, Lower Indian Peaks Lodge. Pass & Ticket Services, Rental, and Retail: Please visit Lower Indian Peaks Lodge. Single-Occupancy Vehicle (SOV) Fees: Vehicles with two or more occupants may park for free seven days a week . Vehicles carrying only a driver will be charged $10 on weekends, during certain holiday periods, and on weekdays with 10 or more inches of new snow. Credit/debit is accepted; cash is not. High-Occupancy Vehicle (HOV) Parking: Per Boulder County requirements, the Elk Lot (nearest to Alpenglow chair) is reserved seven days a week for vehicles with three or more occupants on a first-come, first-served basis. Learn more here . EV Parking: Eldora provides 30 free ChargePoint EV charging stations. These premium parking spots are available on a first-come, first-served basis and are subject to the SOV policy above. To park in the EV lot, you MUST have an EV and be actively charging. If you are finished charging, please move your car to another non-EV space so others can use the chargers. Easy, Convenient RTD Bus Service from Boulder: RTD’s NB route brings you from Downtown Boulder Station straight to the Alpenglow chairlift in about 40 minutes; riders 19 and under ride RTD for FREE through RTD's Zero Fare for Youth program. For schedule and fare info, visit rtd-denver.com .

snowbird.note: Resort Update: The Gadzoom, Wilbere and Chickadee are scheduled to start spinning at 9 a.m., conditions permitting. The Aerial Tram and Little Cloud are expected to have a delayed opening due to high winds at upper elevations. All uphill travel is closed and early-season conditions exist. Please be aware of objects at or below the snow surface. Mountain Report: Happy Saturday! The storm that was forecasted for overnight got caught up in those classic Thanksgiving travel delays and is just now arriving at the mountain. We're now looking at 2-4 inches of fresh snow falling from 6-9a and light flurries continuing through 11a. Strong winds are accompanying the storm, so bundle up and keep an eye out for shifts to lift and terrain status throughout the day. But what about the skiing? How's the skiing?!? It's superb. The bumps are skiing soft and the groomers are holding an edge admirably. I'll be lapping Gadzoom today but you really can't go wrong wherever you choose to make your turns. No events on the calendar today, but might I suggest stopping by The Nest for their incredible Butter Chicken? It's so good that I, personally, consider it a glorious event every time I dig it. It’s early season, so take it easy out there. Ski and ride in control, respect closures and rope lines, and remember that lift and terrain availability can change throughout the day. Give me The Bird.
